post_freeze_backfill_window.note: Dates in this window were backfilled during the post-freeze refresh; they validate tooling but are NOT fresh forward observations and cannot be counted as fresh OOS.

rule_reference: planning P2-2: T0 is the first available execution trading day after the clean baseline freeze; no backfitting with post-T0 data; modifications generate new versions; data revisions must be recorded; forward uses then-visible data and then-rules.
note: No execution calendar day exists after the freeze completion time (2026-08-01). Rerun after the calendar extends beyond the freeze.
